A 67-year-old male with newly diagnosed lung adenocarcinoma, clinical stage IIIA (cT2a N2 M0), is referred for molecular tumor board review before first-line systemic therapy.

The pathology report dated 2026-10-08 identifies an EGFR exon 19 deletion with a variant allele frequency (VAF) of 42% and a PD-L1 tumor proportion score (TPS) of 65%. The referring team is uncertain whether the EGFR mutation should take precedence over the high PD-L1 expression in a patient with mediastinal nodal burden, and whether concurrent chemoradiation remains appropriate in the EGFR-mutant setting.

]
